import pytest
from datetime import date

from payvane.validation.schema_validator import SchemaValidator, ErrorCode
from payvane.validation.schemas import TOKENIZE_REQUEST_SCHEMA

REF = date(2026, 11, 15)


def valid_payload():
    return {
        'merchant': {'merchant_id': 'mch_A1b2C3d4E5f6'},
        'payment': {
            'token': 'tok_visa_0001',
            'card': {'last4': '4242', 'exp_month': 12, 'exp_year': 2027, 'brand': 'visa'},
            'billing': {'postal_code': '94103'},
        },
    }


def make_validator(**kw):
    return SchemaValidator(TOKENIZE_REQUEST_SCHEMA, reference_date=REF, **kw)


def test_valid_payload_has_no_errors():
    assert make_validator().validate(valid_payload()) == []


def test_expired_card_rejected():
    p = valid_payload()
    p['payment']['card']['exp_year'] = 2026
    p['payment']['card']['exp_month'] = 10
    errs = make_validator().validate(p)
    assert [e.code for e in errs] == [ErrorCode.CARD_EXPIRED]
    assert errs[0].path == 'payment.card'


def test_luhn_pan_in_metadata_is_rejected():
    p = valid_payload()
    p['metadata'] = {'note': '4111 1111 1111 1111'}
    errs = make_validator().validate(p)
    assert errs[0].code == ErrorCode.PCI_PAN_DETECTED
    assert '4111' not in errs[0].message


def test_fullwidth_digits_do_not_bypass_pan_check():
    p = valid_payload()
    p['metadata'] = {'note': '４２４２ ４２４２ ４２４２ ４２４２'}
    errs = make_validator().validate(p)
    assert errs[0].code == ErrorCode.PCI_PAN_DETECTED


def test_non_luhn_digit_run_is_allowed():
    p = valid_payload()
    p['metadata'] = {'order_ref': '1234 5678 9012 3456'}
    assert make_validator().validate(p) == []


def test_unknown_field_rejected_in_strict_mode():
    p = valid_payload()
    p['payment']['card']['cvc'] = '123'
    errs = make_validator().validate(p)
    assert [e.code for e in errs] == [ErrorCode.UNKNOWN_FIELD]


def test_unknown_field_allowed_when_not_strict():
    p = valid_payload()
    p['payment']['card']['cvc'] = '123'
    assert make_validator(strict=False).validate(p) == []


def test_deep_nesting_returns_error_not_recursion():
    p = valid_payload()
    node = p['metadata'] = {}
    for _ in range(500):
        node['x'] = {}
        node = node['x']
    errs = make_validator().validate(p)
    assert errs and errs[0].code == ErrorCode.MAX_DEPTH_EXCEEDED
